panels.title: Overall SLO verdict
panels.description: Sums the number of pass() gates currently failing. -1 = WAIT (test isn't yet in steady-state soak — SLOs would be fired on cold-start tail data, which is meaningless). 0 = green PASS, ≥1 = red FAIL. The WAIT gate uses the same two-step phase signal as the Test phase panel: drivers at target AND ≥99 % of CRs Bootstrap-succeeded. Mirrors the runner's pass() — same thresholds, same metrics. The internal-binding-latency gate uses the steady-state-only histogram (M44.4) so it's not skewed by the cold-start fill. Profile-level SLO overrides aren't reflected here; the panel uses in-process tier defaults: cycle ≤ 5 s, rollup ≤ 1 s, ack ≤ 12 s, internal binding ≤ 15 s (ADR-0020), sustained load ≥ 99.9 %, outbox drops = 0, coordinator FSM error rate ≤ 0.1 %.

targets.expr: (((sum(scaletest_loadgen_steady_state) / clamp_min(count(scaletest_loadgen_steady_state), 1)) >= bool 0.999) * ((sum(bigfleet_shard_action_execute_outcomes_total{kind="Bootstrap",outcome="success"}) / clamp_min(sum(scaletest_loadgen_cr_target), 1)) >= bool 0.99)) * (((max(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, pod) (rate(bigfleet_shard_cycle_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))) > bool 5) or vector(0)) + ((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(bigfleet_operator_rollup_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > bool 1) or vector(0)) + ((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(bigfleet_operator_acknowledge_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > bool 12) or vector(0)) + ((sum(rate(bigfleet_operator_outbox_dropped_total[1m])) > bool 0.001) or vector(0)) + ((((sum(rate(bigfleet_coordinator_apply_total{outcome="error"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(bigfleet_coordinator_apply_total[5m])), 1e-9)) > bool 0.001) or vector(0)) + ((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (bigfleet_scaletest_pod_bind_latency_steady_seconds_bucket)) > bool 15) or vector(0)) + (((sum(scaletest_loadgen_cr_active) / clamp_min(sum(scaletest_loadgen_cr_target), 1)) < bool 0.999) or vector(0))) - (1 - (((sum(scaletest_loadgen_steady_state) / clamp_min(count(scaletest_loadgen_steady_state), 1)) >= bool 0.999) * ((sum(bigfleet_shard_action_execute_outcomes_total{kind="Bootstrap",outcome="success"}) / clamp_min(sum(scaletest_loadgen_cr_target), 1)) >= bool 0.99)))

panels.title: Test phase
panels.description: Where the test currently is in its lifecycle. Two-step indicator: (1) all load-drivers have hit their target Pod count, (2) the shard has Bootstrap-succeeded ≥ 99 % of total target (so the cold-start backlog is drained and post-fill steady-tagged Pods bind cleanly). 0 = ramp (load-drivers still filling); 0.5 = filling (load-drivers done but chain still draining the backlog — gate hasn't cleared yet); 1 = steady-state soak (gate cleared, runner is measuring). The runner's gate (M44.4) waits for both signals before transitioning to soak.

panels.title: Time in current phase
panels.description: Wall-clock elapsed since the load-driver entered its current phase. Picks 'steady' if every cluster has reached its target Pod count, otherwise 'ramp'. Sourced from scaletest_loadgen_phase_started_at_seconds — stamped at process start (ramp) and the moment the first cluster hits its target (steady). Useful for reading the dashboard alongside the SLO panel: 'we're 12 min into soak, p99 looks stable' vs 'we're still in ramp, the bind tail is expected'.

panels.title: Bootstraps / target
panels.description: Cumulative Bootstrap-success count vs total CR target (kwok.clusterCount × loadProfile.target). The runner's gate transitions to steady-state soak once this hits ≥ 99 %. Same numerator the Test phase panel reads internally — exposed here so you can watch the chain drain the cold-start backlog. Yellow until 99 %, green at 99 %.

panels.title: Internal binding latency p99 (per-Pod, ADR-0018) — SLO ≤ 15 s (ADR-0020)
panels.description: BigFleet-internal binding latency (the harness fake provider returns instantly; ADR-0018: this is *not* user-facing latency, just BigFleet's contribution). Per-Pod histogram emitted by the bigfleet-scaletest-pod-shim. ADR-0020: 15 s budget = ~10 s rollupInterval ceiling + ~5 s chain headroom. CR-mode opt-out profiles have no shim → metric is empty by design; runner skips the gate via -1 sentinel (ADR-0017).

panels.title: Sustained load — SLO ≥ 99.9 %
panels.description: loadgenCRsActive divided by the load-driver's target. The runner gates on min_over_time of this over the last 5 min of soak; this panel shows the live ratio. Anything < 99.9 % means the load fell off mid-soak and the SLOs are measured against an under-loaded shard.

defaults.noValue: load-driver target metric not exposed (older builds: see panel 1)

panels.title: Shards reporting cycle — SLO = replicas
panels.description: Counts shard pods publishing bigfleet_shard_cycle_duration_seconds. Less than shard.replicas means at least one shard is crash-looping or wedged; the per-pod max(by pod) aggregation in cycle p99 silently excludes missing pods so this gate catches them.

panels.title: Coordinator FSM error rate — SLO ≤ 0.1 %
panels.description: FSM Apply error rate on the coordinator leader. > 0.001 means Raft is rejecting commands or the FSM is returning errors — coordinator-side correctness violation.

panels.title: Operator outbox drops / sec — SLO 0
panels.description: Operator session-outbox drops. > 0 means the operator stream lost frames silently. Different from rollup/ack timeout — these are dropped messages, full stop.

panels.title: Shortfalls
panels.description: bigfleet_shard_shortfalls — unsatisfied demand the shard couldn't resolve this cycle. Reported, not gated by pass() — shortfalls are a bigfleet_shard_shortfalls_aged escalation signal, not a binary fail.

panels.title: Failed machines
panels.description: bigfleet_shard_inventory_machines{state="Failed"}. Includes M38 spot/hardware-fault simulator + execute-path Bootstrap timeouts (ADR-0019 followup). Reported, not gated.

panels.title: Bootstraps cumulative vs target — runner gate at 99 %
panels.description: Cumulative count of successful Bootstrap actions (sum across shards) plotted against the runner's gate threshold. Same numerator the Test phase + Overall verdict panels read. The gate trips at 99 % (the dashed target line × 0.99) — once the curve crosses, the runner transitions ramp → steady-state soak. Lets you watch the chain drain the cold-start backlog visually instead of decoding the runner's stdout.

panels.title: Internal binding latency p99 — chain decomposition (Drop Q + R, SLO line 15 s)
panels.description: ADR-0018: BigFleet's internal contribution only (fake provider returns instantly). ADR-0020 SLO: 15 s = ~10 s rollupInterval ceiling + ~5 s chain headroom. (A) e2e per-Pod from the pod-shim — the SLO-bearing line. (B-E) the four measured hops between Pod creation and Pod bound, ordered upstream-to-downstream so the line carrying the tail is visible at a glance. configurePhase is the shard's Configuring→Configured wall-clock (Drop R); requestBootstrap is its inner stream-RPC subset; upcomingToNode is pod-shim's fake-Node reconciler from UpcomingNode creation to Node Create (Drop Q); nodeToBound is pod-shim's binder from fake-Node creation to Bind success. Stages don't simply sum to e2e — slow Pods can stack one bad hop on otherwise-fast hops — but whichever line tracks e2e owns the tail.

targets.legendFormat: shard: drainPhase p99 (Drop W — Reclaim symmetric)

panels.title: Shard cycle p99 (worst shard) — envelope line at 5 s

targets.expr: max by (phase) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, pod, phase) (rate(bigfleet_shard_cycle_phase_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))))

panels.title: Operator rollup p99 — SLO line at 1 s
Operator acknowledge p99 — SLO line at 12 s
Phase 1 sub-path mean duration
panels.description: ADR-0019: per-sub-path attribution of Phase 1 wall-clock. take is the head-cursor walk; takeCoLocated is the Same-rack bucket pick (the cloud-only hot path the operator's owner-grouping forces every Pod-derived Need through); takeSpread is the strict-spread bucket pick. After M44.4's optimisation, the cached bucketing + per-bucket head cursors should drop takeCoLocated mean to sub-millisecond.

panels.title: Phase 1 sub-path call rate
panels.description: Calls per second by sub-path. takeCoLocated dominating reflects the Pod → CR → Same(rack) translation at scale; take dominating reflects single-archetype profiles without sameRack.

panels.title: Phase 1 sub-path CPU share (sum/sec)
panels.description: How much wall-clock per second of soak each sub-path consumes. ≈1.0 means the sub-path is fully saturating one shard CPU; ≪1 means it's fine. Pre-M44.4 takeCoLocated landed near 1.0 at scaleway-50k.

panels.title: Phase 1 pool build duration (cache miss cost)
panels.description: buildPoolSource time per (state, fingerprint). Cached after first build per cycle; high values here mean pool merging+sorting (multi-instance-type profiles) is dominating, not the take path.

panels.title: Pod-mode chain stage cumulative — per stage
panels.description: From load-driver Pod creates down to fake-Node bindings. Watch the gap between consecutive stages — that's where the chain throttles. Right after gate-cleared the curves should track each other; if they diverge, identify the rate-limited stage by which curve flattens first.

panels.title: Pipeline stage rate (events / sec)
panels.description: Per-stage events per second. Equal rates = chain in steady-state; the slowest curve here is the throttling stage.

panels.title: Action execute outcomes by reason
panels.description: Drop A diagnostic: which return path silently dropped Bootstraps. no_session = operator stream gone for that cluster (the M44.4 hypothesis); transition_error = state-machine refused; blob_error = bootstrap-blob fetch failed; provider_error = fake provider rejected; ctx_canceled = cycleCtx timeout.

panels.title: Operator sessions: active count + lifecycle rate
panels.description: active = current count of installed sessions; should equal cluster.replicas for the shard. installed/removed/replaced = lifecycle event rate; high replaced rate = grpc keepalive churn under load.

panels.title: handleNodeStateUpdate p99 by phase
panels.description: End-to-end wall-clock for the operator's NodeStateUpdate handler. Each call does a Get (cache), a Create-or-Update for spec, and a Status().Update. p99 above ~100 ms means apiserver writes are queued behind the per-op QPS limiter or there's controller-runtime cache lag forcing extra round-trips.

panels.title: UpcomingNode write rate by op + outcome
panels.description: Rate of UpcomingNode CRD apiserver writes from the operator, split by op (create/spec_update/status_update) and outcome (success/conflict/error). Sum / NodeStateUpdate-rate ≈ apiserver round-trips per binding (expected ~2 for fresh, 1 for status-only updates). High conflict rate = controller-runtime cache disagreeing with apiserver under burst.

panels.title: Operator dispatch goroutines in flight
panels.description: Currently-running stream-dispatch goroutines per operator. recvLoop spawns one goroutine per inbound frame with no semaphore — sustained high values mean apiserver-write back-pressure (per-cluster QPS limiter draining slower than the inbound stream). Pair with handleNodeStateUpdate p99 to confirm.

panels.title: Shard execute() goroutines in flight
panels.description: Currently-running execute() goroutines on the shard (configured cap = executeConcurrency, default 128). Sustained at the cap = parallelism-bound; well below the cap with low chain throughput = downstream bottleneck (operator stream RTT or blob fetch).
